title: RBI Penalty on Bank of Baroda for Fair Practices Code and KYC Non-Compliance
description: <cite index="37-3,37-4,37-5">The RBI imposed a total penalty of Rs. 66.7 lakh on Bank of Baroda and GIC Housing Finance for violations related to regulatory compliance, with Bank of Baroda fined Rs. 63.6 lakh for non-compliance with provisions of the Fair Practices Code for Lenders and Know Your Customer (KYC) guidelines.</cite> <cite index="37-7,37-8">The regulator found that the public sector lender had charged interest above the contracted rate in certain loan accounts and failed to upload KYC records of some customers to the Central KYC Records Registry within the prescribed timeline.</cite>
